name: generate_plan
description: Generate a detailed action plan based on user requirements.

plan.description: The main subject or goal of the plan (e.g., 'a tour to Beijing').

theme.description: The theme or category of the plan (e.g., 'Business action plan').

style.description: The preferred style of the plan (e.g., 'casual', 'formal').

additional_requirements.description: Any additional requirements such as budget considerations or timeline.
